messages:
sara (AE): Hey team — onboarding call with Orion AM at 1pm tomorrow. They want a tight POC scope to unblock procurement. Main asks: latency SLA, golden prompt set, pricing for a 2-week pilot + Dedicated option. Any blockers?

mike (SE): Thanks. Quick notes from tech presales POV: we should lock the eval harness and golden set before we run load tests. Also need to confirm whether they can share sample customer queries (PII redacted).

andrew (Solutions): Proposed success criteria draft:
- Functional: >= 0.8 average quality score on golden set (manual + automated rubric)
- Latency: p95 < 220ms on Hosted, < 150ms on Dedicated during 50 RPS sustained
- Stability: 99.9% availability for the test window
- Regression gate: no more than 3% newly-regressed examples vs seed baseline

sara (AE): Nice. Orion also asked about pricing granularity — can we give a pilot quote that covers burst on Hosted + option to upgrade to Dedicated mid-pilot?

mike (SE): Yes, we can propose billed Hosted baseline + optional Dedicated uplift. For the POC keep the numbers simple: hosted tokens + a flat reserved buffer if they want Dedicated during the pilot. I'll add numbers after we map their expected QPS.

kevin (Security): Re: security questionnaire — they pushed back on data residency and VPC peering. We need to confirm:
- whether the pilot can run in our EU region for their EU customers
- VPC peering for Private/Dedicated trial (we support peering + customer-managed KMS)
- audit logs retention — 90d is our default, can extend via add-on

julia (Legal): Also check IP/data ownership language for pilot data. We typically include a clause that transient logs and prompts may be used for product improvement unless opted out for enterprise pilots.

sara (AE): I'll ask them to sign the pilot addendum to opt-out if needed.

mike (SE): For the eval harness: proposed structure for golden prompts and scoring — sharing a quick example we plan to run (feel free to comment):

```
# Golden prompts (seed set) - each item has a human rating + automated rubric
1) "Summarize the following policy excerpt into 3 bullets." -> expected: concise summary, preserve negations
2) "Rewrite customer ticket into an internal dev bug report with severity." -> expected: canonical fields (summary, steps, severity)
3) "Extract payer name and payment amount from receipt text." -> expected: structured JSON with keys: payer_name, amount_cents
```

Scoring rubric (automated + human):
- 0-1 token-level heuristics for structure (JSON validity)
- Semantic score via cosine on embeddings + threshold (>=0.78 pass)
- Human spot-check: 15% of examples sampled, avg human score >= 3/5
- Regression gate: at most 3% of golden set drop below pass threshold compared to baseline

andrew (Solutions): We should also add latency-sensitive prompts to the harness for tail behavior (long context, function-calling examples).

kevin (Security): For the security questionnaire blockers: they asked about export controls and on-prem capability. We can offer Private deployment for full on-prem, but that'll add ~4 week lead time and a different contract. Flag this as procurement risk.

sara (AE): Good call. I'll surface the timelines: POC proposed timeline = 3 weeks total
- Week 0 (preflight): sample data + security Q answered + golden set finalized
- Week 1: baseline runs, basic qualitative evals, small perf test (10 RPS)
- Week 2: scaled perf (50 RPS), regression checks, hand-off to Orion devs to run integration tests
- Week 3 (wrap): final report + decision point (go/no-go, Dedicated uplift or Private discussion)

mike (SE): Action items:
- Mike: build eval harness skeleton + placeholder golden set by EOD tomorrow
- Andrew: draft success criteria doc and scoring templates
- Kevin: send minimal security answers (VPC peering, KMS, region availability)
- Sara: get sample queries from Orion + confirm procurement timeline

sara (AE): @andrew can we include a short statement on pricing options to send with the POC SOW? They asked for a simple table (pilot hosted / pilot dedicated uplift / private eval)

andrew (Solutions): Yes — I'll add a short pricing table and note assumptions (token mix, expected QPS, retention). Will attach as a PDF to the SOW.

kevin (Security): One more blocker flagged by Orion: they need SOC2 attestation copy before pilot kickoff. Ops-bot, can we attach latest SOC2 link?

ops-bot: SOC2 report (redacted) available at https://redwood.example.com/compliance/soc2-2025 (access req'd)

julia (Legal): If they require a full NDA-level carveout for prompts, push back on unlimited retention opt-out — we can offer a time-limited retention clause for the pilot.

sara (AE): Great — next sync tomorrow 9:30am to finalize golden set. I'll send the calendar invite and include Orion attendees. :thumbsup:

mike (SE): Quick question — for embedding-based semantic score threshold, recommend we run a small calibration on their sample queries to set the 0.78 baseline. Otherwise we risk false fails.

andrew (Solutions): Agreed. Add calibration run to Week 0 checklist.

sara (AE): Thanks everyone — ping me in thread if anything slips.
